cohort: 515 Jordanian women recruited as a convenient sample from public maternity and children's health centres in the Irbid Directorate in Jordan.
finding: A high prevalence of physical (75.7%), verbal (29.9%), and psycho-affective (37.1%) obstetric violence was found among Jordanian women, with factors like mode of delivery and complicated delivery being significant risk factors.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was significantly associated with physical and psycho-affective obstetric violence.
cross-section timing: Data was collected cross-sectionally, retrospectively assessing experiences during childbirth.
